description: Reusable authored-pose direction for artificer player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies clockwork-tool choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: inventive, mechanical, precise, and brisk, with articulated tool use, clockwork recoil, deliberate gadget deployment, and readable weight transfer
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's goggles, mechanical arm, gears, toolbelt, gadgets, tools, clothing, and exact item count. Keep every mechanism attached as depicted; move exactly one established handheld gadget at a time and never duplicate, swap, or transform permanent machinery.
identity.magicRule: Effects are physical clockwork, steam, sparks, or compact gadget discharge in the portrait's established palette. Do not add arcane runes, unexplained aura, summoned machinery, or oversized explosions.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, goggles, mechanical arm, gears, toolbelt, gadgets, clothing, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact clockwork-inventor silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered artificer in a tool-ready diagnostic stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall artificer motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, goggles, mechanical arm, gears, palette, proportions, toolbelt, gadgets, and mechanisms. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A busy diagnostic loop alternates measured breath, goggle adjustment, mechanical-arm checks, and one secured toolbelt inspection.
idle.effectRule: Only a tiny gear motion, indicator glint, or contained steam tick is permitted; no deployed gadget.
frameDescriptions: tool-ready stance with mechanisms secured

weight shifts forward during a goggle adjustment
free hand checks one attached gear or indicator
centered diagnostic midpoint
controlled exhale as mechanism settles
weight shifts rearward while toolbelt stops swaying
tool-ready stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A brisk alternating stride uses real leg compression, mechanical-arm counter-motion, toolbelt stabilization, and delayed gear and coat follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active discharge; attached mechanisms remain closed and singular.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact with toolbelt stabilized
left leg compresses under mechanical weight
passing pose with right knee advancing
right foot reaches as mechanical arm counter-swings
right foot forward contact

passing pose with left knee advancing
left foot reaches into the brisk loop

attack.motionDirection: A quick diagnosis selects exactly one established gadget, primes it with the mechanical arm or tool, drives a compact strike or discharge, and retracts safely.
attack.effectRule: Use exactly one handheld or attached gadget and one compact spark, steam, or physical contact accent; no duplicate machinery or oversized blast.
frameDescriptions: diagnostic guard assessing the target
hand reaches toward exactly one established gadget

planted windup aligns mechanical arm and tool

mechanical recoil travels through shoulders and stance
gadget retracts or returns as sparks fade
recovered tool-ready guard

hurt.motionDirection: An impact jolts the mechanisms, throws the body into a stagger, triggers a low protective brace, rapid diagnostic check, and determined recovery.
hurt.effectRule: A few compact physical sparks may leave an established mechanism; no gore, blood, detached arm, duplicated parts, or explosion.
frameDescriptions: tool-ready stance before impact
sharp flinch with mechanical arm drawn inward

forced backward step with toolbelt swinging
low brace protecting attached mechanisms
careful rise during a rapid diagnostic check
feet, arm, and tools reset
recovered inventive guard

death.motionDirection: A final impact powers down the machinery, knees buckle under gear weight, the body lowers into a side collapse, and all attached mechanisms settle fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Sparks and steam fade without gore, blood, explosion, detached machinery, duplicate parts, or rigid rotation.

knees buckle beneath the gear load
one hip grounds while torso and mechanical arm tip sideways
body reaches full ground contact
tools, gears, limbs, and clothing settle low
final fully fallen artificer with mechanisms inert
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The artificer confirms success, checks one mechanism, adjusts goggles, raises exactly one gadget, triggers a tiny celebratory function, secures it, and holds proudly.
victory.effectRule: One selected gadget may emit a tiny spark, steam puff, or gear flourish; never duplicate it or create a large blast.
